description: Tutorial catalogue for the V1.0.0 release tree. Asset labels use the canonical ci_light and full_v1 profiles; CI-light selection does not redefine supported scoring.

gate_definitions.v1_smoke: Fast, stable tutorial run used for compact local and CI-light checks.
gate_definitions.v1_release: Normal supported V1 tutorial set after the full_v1 install.
gate_definitions.v1_extended: Valid V1 tutorial retained for slower confidence runs.
gate_definitions.v1_partial_recovery: Partial-recovery tutorial where exact recovery is not required; recovery quality must be reported.
gate_definitions.v1_slow_demo: Working demo that is too slow for the normal release set.
gate_definitions.v1_full_assets: Supported tutorial requiring the full_v1 language-asset profile.
gate_definitions.broken_contract_fix_needed: Tutorial or helper has an API mismatch; exclude until fixed.
gate_definitions.wrapper_script_fix_needed: Wrapper/import script issue; exclude until fixed.
gate_definitions.remove_from_pure_release: Unwanted in pure release tree; remove only after explicit review.

tutorials.title: Two-period cribs: fast public walkthrough
tutorials.notes: Requires the full_v1 LM1-LM4 profile because the retained S2-B1-F1 solver ends with the unchanged F1 char1-4/WLI1-4 scorer. Fast exact public API walkthrough; three deterministic exact runs measured at 1.615-1.686 seconds of solver wall time.

tutorials.title: Two-period cribs: genuine P13/P31 d14 interruptor search
tutorials.notes: A2 genuine non-zero d14 P13/P31 staged search with a two-position interruptor pool and fixed count one. The decoy at 192 contradicts the fixed crib before staged search; the true interruptor at 300 leaves the retained d14 crib-derived affine space identical to the proven pre-A2 search, while still exercising structural removal in the tail. The pre-A2 no-interruptor form measured about 260 seconds; this updated form requires fresh full-profile evidence.

tutorials.title: Two-period cribs with structural interruptor pool search
tutorials.notes: A2 structural interruptor example. Uses the normal two_period_cribs route with a three-position pool and fixed count of two; the true interruptor positions are not supplied to the solver. Requires full_v1 because the staged route retains the unchanged F1 char1-4/WLI1-4 scorer.

tutorials.title: Start here: seeded Vigenere interface and general-map beam solve
tutorials.notes: Basic interface tutorial. The wrapper call explicitly supplies the known key and is not presented as independent cryptanalysis; the General Map call is unseeded.

tutorials.title: Autokey older GA/crib-assisted comparison
tutorials.notes: Historical lighter GA comparison using the earlier char2/WLI2 scorer; not the qualified robust Beam recipe.

tutorials.title: Autokey robust Beam solve
tutorials.notes: Qualified WLI1+2 Beam recipe with three internal restarts; truth is terminal-only.

tutorials.title: Railfence beam solve
tutorials.notes: Qualified Beam recipe and public cipher construction; fixed budget without oracle stop.

tutorials.title: Vigenere known-position interruptor interface demonstration
tutorials.notes: Known-position interface demonstration over realistic text; the fixture key is not supplied to the solver and unknown-position search remains out of scope.

tutorials.title: Columnar transposition
tutorials.notes: Good release tutorial; exact recovery under ci_light. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Vigenere via General Map API
tutorials.notes: Shows user-defined/general-map path. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Vigenere smaller single-start interruptor Beam pool search
tutorials.notes: Small real single-start Beam pool search; not the qualified three-restart recipe.

tutorials.title: Mono-substitution lighter single-attempt GA RTL
tutorials.notes: Lighter single-attempt demonstration using the earlier char2/WLI2 scorer; not the qualified robust recipe.

tutorials.title: Mono-substitution lighter single-attempt GA LTR
tutorials.notes: Lighter single-attempt demonstration using the earlier char2/WLI2 scorer; not the qualified robust recipe.

tutorials.title: Mono-substitution robust three-attempt GA

tutorials.title: Repeating multiply mod 29
tutorials.notes: Good extended custom-map demo. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Mono-substitution hybrid RTL
tutorials.notes: Higher quality mono result than GA, but slower. Directional RTL pretty-print variant promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Vigenere larger single-start interruptor Beam search
tutorials.notes: Larger single-start Beam search; not the qualified three-restart recipe.

tutorials.notes: Qualified Beam-64 three-restart unknown-position pool search; truth is terminal-only.

tutorials.title: ScheduledStreamLookup P13 plus supplied sequence
tutorials.notes: Promoted to default release gate as the exact ScheduledStreamLookup real-solve proof under ci_light. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: ScheduledStreamLookup P13 plus generated primes
tutorials.notes: Exact real key-recovery tutorial under ci_light; retained in full_v1/extended to avoid making default release too heavy. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: ScheduledStreamLookup segmented P13/P31/P13 partial-recovery tutorial
tutorials.notes: Keep as partial recovery. Exact recovery is not required under ci_light. Pretty-print partial-recovery tutorial promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Liber Primus Welcome Pilgrim label solve
tutorials.notes: Thin wrapper over solving/solved_lp/02_Welcome_Pilgrim.py. Loads welcome_pilgrim by LP source label and requires exact solved evidence. Pretty-print version promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Mono-substitution simulated annealing LTR
tutorials.notes: Works but slow; not default release gate. Directional LTR pretty-print variant promoted to canonical V1 tutorial filename.

tutorials.title: Periodic columnar P7/C7 qualification-derived warm start
tutorials.notes: LONG-RUNNING KAEDING QUALIFICATION: qualification-derived public API warm-start solve, approximately 40 minutes on the qualified machine. One score-selected non-answer seed, one Kaeding restart, target_score=None and terminal-only truth. Requires full_v1 assets and is excluded from normal fast, release, extended and ci_light run sets.
